edit.ability:
(1PG) After this creature takes damage for the first time, begin morbing, healing 2 HP per turn while morbing.
At this end of this creature's 2nd turn morbing, cease morbing and become fully morbed, gaining [dark] type, +1 DEF, and 50% lifesteal on attacks.
(1PG) After attacking once, begin YIIKing out, gaining +1 SPD while YIIKing.
At this end of this creature's 2nd turn YIIKing, cease YIIKing, and gain +2 ATK and +1 SPD.
